claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Tremorine is a muscarinic acetylcholine receptor agonist that at 2.5 uM is unlikely to kill cancer cells; any antiproliferative effect would be weak and non-selective, consistent with its identification as a hit in a breast cancer repurposing screen rather than a cytotoxic mechanism.
